purpose: SYNTHETIC: This box administers the household of Odette Marlowe. Include matters about her household, its legal process, accounts, property, or household correspondence. Exclude generic marketing and unrelated personal mail, even from contacts who also handle household matters.

rules.legal: Court, property disputes, legal representation, and legal notices specifically concerning this household. Exclude generic legal marketing.
rules.financial: Bank accounts, account closure, tax, and other financial administration specifically concerning this household. Property repair invoices go to property instead.
rules.property: Maintenance, valuation, sale, and repairs of property belonging to this household, including associated repair invoices.
